verdict.rationale: AMD's docs let users tune power via PBO/Ryzen Master but don't publish explicit sustained power-envelope figures, and independent reviews (TechPowerUp, Tom's Hardware) confirm strong productivity/render performance and call it 'energy efficient' without giving detailed sustained-load per-watt or thermal-throttle-avoidance data for long export workloads. Missing for 10: documented sustained power limits (PPT/TDC/EDC) for long workloads, independent long-render thermal/power-draw charts, and explicit perf-per-watt comparisons against competitors.
